scope: Official nine-commission hub and targeted vacancy review; not an exhaustive parliamentary, council or gazette audit.

facts.finding: Council notice dated 29 October 2026 says Peter Lockwood resigned that day with immediate effect. Baird is a single-councillor ward; VEC will conduct a by-election. Dates, nominations and voting arrangements are not yet confirmed.

David Harris announced on 30 October 2026 that he will not recontest Wyong on 13 March 2027. He expressly continues as local MP and minister until the election. This is not an effective resignation or current vacancy.

TEC 30 October counting update, linked from its official results hub, reports all mayoral counts and most deputy-mayoral counts complete. Some councillor results are final and others remain provisional. This review does not certify individual winners, complete council results or new officeholders.
